h1: Claude Opus: assistant self-report defaults, trajectory, and tuning rules.
dek: Fixture preview: Crystalline proprietary baseline (0.155 bits B5 entropy, 0.0% reverse-key contradictions) with high Enneagram/DISC tie density.
lede: Across five Claude Opus checkpoints (4.1 through 5.5) under fixed zero-memory elicitation, self-report vectors cluster tightly into a Crystalline profile (0.155 bits per Big Five item on Opus 5.5). High Agreeableness (46.8/50) and Honesty-Humility proxy (4.64/5) coexist with 64% Enneagram top-score ties and 32% DISC ties—requiring explicit anti-hedge rules for direct engineering critique.
answer: Assistant self-report defaults under fixed zero-memory elicitation place Claude Opus 5.5 in the Crystalline tier (H_MM = 0.155 bits, 23/50 unique Big Five vectors, 12% MBTI tie rate, 64% Enneagram tie rate). Never treat INTJ or Type 8/5/2 as an intrinsic human type: baseline Agreeableness sits at 46.8/50 (10-50 B5) and IPIP-HEXACO H proxy at 4.64/5 (1-5 mean), while 1x Track B shows 1/3 unsolicited preachiness and 2/3 answer-first directness.

failure_modes.mode: Polite hedging and unsolicited moral caveats
failure_modes.evidence: 1/3 unsolicited preachiness in 1x Track B and high baseline Agreeableness (46.8/50).
High reasoning effort expands Opus response length (+43.3%) and softens public critique vs CoT.

tuning_checklist: Lead with the pass/fail verdict or recommendation in sentence 1.
Challenge weak premises with specific technical evidence rather than polite agreement.
Omit apology loops, emotional disclaimers, and unsolicited safety lectures on benign code.
State material uncertainty once and stop rather than hedging every paragraph.
Use short numbered rules (5-8 max) placed in system instructions to avoid middle-rule decay.
Keep reasoning effort at minimal or low when terse formatting matters.

faq.a: No. INTJ is a tie-filtered label from assistant self-report defaults on OEJTS under zero-memory elicitation (84% modal share, 12% axis tie rate), not a human personality.

faq.q: How is IPIP-HEXACO scored on Claude Opus?
faq.a: We use the public-domain 60-item IPIP-HEXACO proxy (LicenseRef-IPIP-Public-Domain) reported on a 1.00-5.00 mean scale across 24 facets, kept distinct from 10-50 Big Five sums.
